07 Our Environmental Stewardship
7.1 Water Stewardship
We are committed to minimising our impact on the environment through deliberate
management of our water use. We installed a water solution that guarantees a consistent
supply of safe drinking water, through purification units that connect to portable water
systems. These systems purify and dispense water at designated locations while simultaneously
eliminating the need for single-use plastic water bottles. Sanlam Tower is also fitted with sensors and
slow-flow taps in the washrooms that prevent water wastage. In 2024, water usage at Sanlam Tower

7.3 Waste Management, Reduction of Plastic and Paper Use
In 2024, Sanlam General Insurance implemented bottle-less water dispensers at its Head office,
resulting in actual cost savings of KShs 113,473 and significantly reducing plastic waste. Sanlam
Life Insurance had implemented the bottle-less-water dispensers at its Head Office and branch
network in 2022. Additionally, collaboration with organisations like the WEEE Centre facilitated
electronic waste (e-waste) collection drives, promoting responsible disposal at Sanlam Towers. We
implemented waste segregation at Sanlam Towers in 2024, separating recyclables, organic, paper,
plastics and non-recyclable hazardous waste segregated at source.
